words.title: Pellow Yoga: book a yoga class in Leith, Edinburgh
words.heroLead: Drop-in and weekly yoga classes, Monday to Saturday, £11.50 a class.
words.regularsLead: This device remembers your email and your last class, so booking it again is one button.
words.classesLead: Monday 16 to Saturday 21 November, up to 14 mats in each class.
words.classBody: Long holds, simple standing poses and the breath counted out loud. The pace stays even for the whole hour, and every pose has an easier version you can take at any point.
words.confirmTitle: Book a place in a class
words.confirmLead: No account needed. Just your name and email. You pay at the studio.
words.confirmSent: Your class is booked. The confirmation email is on its way.
words.bookedBody: Your place is held the moment you book. The confirmation email names the class, the time and the teacher, and there is nothing to bring but yourself.
